pool.domain: Systems of Linear Equations & Row Reduction
pool.text: Consider the following system of linear equations represented by the augmented matrix: \[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & | & 5 \\ 2 & -1 & | & 0 \end{pmatrix} \]. Use row reduction to transform the matrix into row-echelon form and determine the unique solution \( (x, y) \) for the system. What is the value of \( x \)?
pool.educational_aim: Demonstrate foundational mastery of Systems of Linear Equations & Row Reduction by solving direct algebraic, graphical, or geometric formulations tested on LINALG past papers.
pool.exam_archetype: Systems of Linear Equations & Row Reduction — Direct Concept & Representation
pool.sol:
We are given the augmented matrix: \[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & | & 5 \\ 2 & -1 & | & 0 \end{pmatrix} \]
To transform this matrix into row-echelon form, we can perform the following row operation: \( R_2 \leftarrow R_2 - 2R_1 \).
\[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & | & 5 \\ 2 - 2(1) & -1 - 2(2) & | & 0 - 2(5) \end{pmatrix} \]
\[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & | & 5 \\ 0 & -5 & | & -10 \end{pmatrix} \]
Now, we can perform another row operation: \( R_2 \leftarrow R_2 / -5 \).
\[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & | & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & | & 2 \end{pmatrix} \]
This matrix is now in row-echelon form. The corresponding system of equations is:
\( x + 2y = 5 \)
\( y = 2 \)
Substitute the value of \( y \) into the first equation:
\( x + 2(2) = 5 \)
\( x + 4 = 5 \)
\( x = 1 \)
Therefore, the unique solution is \( (1, 2) \), and the value of \( x \) is 1.

Use the resulting form to finish: \(x + 4\).
